description:
Why a piece's story is where it is on the list: its rank and score, the mains at the edition's home and at
the world, its scores each under its title, the stakes that lifted it, what cut a main (no outlet abroad told
it, a routine notice), who carried it, who it is about, what is just above and below, and what near it was
left out and why.
name: why
title: Why it is here
